_doc: Sample portfolios, North American investor POV. Countries ISO3. 'country' = domicile/home market; 'ops' = main operating countries when different; ETFs: 'primary_countries' is a qualitative look-through hint (use issuer holdings files for weights). Tickers are US/TSX/OTC listings checked as of mid-2026; verify at as_of. 'portfolios' = 15 risk-method test portfolios, 10+ holdings each (5 safe, 5 medium, 5 dangerous; 'expected_score' = objective score from the formula on cached inputs, 2026-11-15). 'showcase_portfolios' = Luc's exaggerated set; 'legacy_portfolios' = the original samples.

portfolios.label: Maple Bunker
portfolios.geo_angle: Half Canadian government/IG bonds, half Canadian blue chips (banks, utility, rail, retail, software): one stable G7 country, mostly domestic revenue.

portfolios.label: Home Dividend
portfolios.geo_angle: Canadian bonds plus dividend payers (utility, banks, insurer, pipeline, rail) and the TSX 60: home-country risk only.

portfolios.label: Andes & Maple
portfolios.geo_angle: Canadian bonds and blue chips plus a domestic Chilean bank: two low-hazard, low-tension countries.

portfolios.label: Two Quiet Democracies
portfolios.geo_angle: Canadian bonds and blue chips plus two Japanese megabanks: stable democracies, mostly domestic revenue.

portfolios.label: Pacific Rim Banks
portfolios.geo_angle: Canadian bonds plus domestic banks in Canada, Chile, Japan and Korea: low hazard, home-market lenders.

portfolios.label: World Economy 60/40
portfolios.geo_angle: Global 60/40: US + international equities, US and Canadian bonds, a few global large caps; world-economy-like exposure.

portfolios.label: Emerging Mix
portfolios.geo_angle: Broad emerging markets (India, Brazil, Indonesia, Mexico, Peru, China via VWO) plus EM sovereign debt: higher fragility, limited war exposure.

portfolios.label: Latin Banks & Telcos
portfolios.geo_angle: Latin American banks, telecoms and consumer staples: Brazil, Mexico, Peru, Colombia, Chile; moderate instability, low war risk.

portfolios.label: European Blue Chips
portfolios.geo_angle: European large caps (Germany, Netherlands, UK, France, Switzerland, Denmark, Spain): stable but war-adjacent news coverage, global revenue.

portfolios.label: North American Core
portfolios.geo_angle: S&P 500, US and Canadian bonds, US mega-caps and a Canadian bank: one high-GPR-tension country balanced by Canada.

portfolios.label: All-In China
portfolios.geo_angle: Mainland China internet, EV and consumer names plus Taiwan chip packagers: sanctions, delisting, Taiwan Strait escalation.

portfolios.label: MENA Hotspots
portfolios.geo_angle: Israel defence, pharma and cyber, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Nigeria/Egypt e-commerce, African telecom, China EV.

portfolios.label: Sanctions Basket
portfolios.geo_angle: Sanctions and conflict basket: Israel defence/cyber, Turkey, China EV and e-commerce, Taiwan telecom, Africa, crypto.

portfolios.label: Levant & Bosphorus
portfolios.geo_angle: Israel at war plus Turkey: defence, pharma, cyber, Turkish telecom, topped up with China, Taiwan, Saudi and Africa.

portfolios.label: Israel at War
portfolios.geo_angle: Israel concentration (defence contractor, pharma, cyber, software) under active conflict, plus Turkey, China and Taiwan.
